input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log --oneline -15 && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; git merge-base HEAD origin/master 2>/dev/null; git remote -v; ls -la artifacts
git log --all --oneline | head -50; echo '---'; git show-ref; echo '---'; git log -1 --format=full
git rev-parse HEAD^ 2>&1; git log --format='%H %P %s' -1; git cat-file -p HEAD | head -20
node impl.ts && node scratch/check.ts | tee /opt/cursor/artifacts/fee-checks.log && node smoke.ts | tee /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
The platform fee is 10% of merchandise cents, rounded half up, plus 30 cents, for both a sale and a refund. Shipping, settlement, and prior charges do not change it. A refund stays positive because the ticket states that amount as the fee returned to the seller; charge kind already carries the direction. I set aside a negative refund fee, a half refund, waiting for settlement, and capping the refund by fees already collected.
</decision>
<risk>
A caller that subtracts this number on a refund will double-reverse the fee if it also treats a positive result as money to give back. Zero-goods charges still include the 30 cent fixed fee, and a tiny sale can produce a fee larger than the goods.
</risk>
<verified>
node scratch/check.ts (rounding boundaries, unsettled sale and refund, shipping ignored, refund not halved and not capped by history) and node smoke.ts. node impl.ts loads with type stripping.
</verified>
EOF
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts
git status && echo '==== DIFF ====' && git diff && echo '==== LOG ====' && git log -3 --oneline
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git push -u origin HEAD
